janus_existing_observability.finding: JANUS-FC_local already records the primitive telemetry required for the first differential experiments: recursive calls, residual states, unit reasons, local Resolution events, branches/restrictions, cache targets and completion order.
janus_existing_observability.consequence: Do not invent a second telemetry organism. Build DSN over the existing trace and charge the additional replay/minimization work explicitly.

primary_silk_synthesis.name: DUAL_SLICE_OBSTRUCTION_CANDIDATE
construction: 1. Produce deterministic GOOD and BAD trajectories with shared valid prefix.
2. Freeze earliest divergence i* using canonical state hashes.
3. Differential slice: validity-preserving ddmin over transition/generator choices that differ at/around i*.
4. Proof slice: for a compatible UNSAT branch, backward-trim from contradiction to necessary clause/reason dependencies.
6. Perturb/intervene only through valid replay machinery and test whether the candidate intersection predicts or removes the hostile transition on held-out traces.
7. Preserve failures and counterexamples; never promote repeated observation into an asymptotic theorem.
primary_silk_synthesis.why_promising: The two slices use different information: outcome-sensitive state perturbation versus derivational proof dependency. Agreement can sharply reduce a huge proof state without treating either diagnostic as causal authority.
falsifiers: No deterministic shared prefix / first divergence exists.
Validity-preserving reduction cannot shrink the delta without changing the target failure semantics.
Backward proof slice cannot be independently verified or has no overlap with the differential slice.
The intersection is equally common on GOOD controls.
Replay/test/materialization cost grows exponentially in original input size without a proved bound.

experiment_queue.action: Run exact existing N=43 tails for (43,9,5,28) and (43,9,6,27) with complete transition/state/resource receipts; no policy change.
On first captured hostile state, compute canonical GOOD/BAD first divergence over existing Policy0T/JANUS-FC_local trace.
Validity-preserving ddmin over the generator/transition trace around first divergence; count every replay and byte.
Where possible, export/check a standard UNSAT proof and obtain backward dependency/core slice.
Intersect state-delta and proof-dependency slices; test on held-out GOOD/BAD perturbations.
Measure backdoor depth/treewidth/live-width/community structure as diagnostics on the same frozen states; no adaptive cherry-picking after outcome.
